cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I planned the picnic, so I choose cake first. Planning sits above delivery; let's use the correct order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Transport. Second place, please. Choosing the destination comes before taking people to it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I baked the cake. The baker gets the big end piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Baking goes above transport, yes. But I commissioned the cake, so put commissioning first. Cut my end piece before revising the rest of the list.

reason: Replace generic tone labels with A precise classification and cutting instructions that serve repeated self-benefiting rank changes.
